# date selection and test contract (before tests)

Base: 08d4bc5b7e26c2016bfc2594dcfd711abd044a37; isolated archive only.
Course SQLite: data/02/CLI_Tools.docx paragraphs 233–235: show system time,
-h/--help. Human-tool JSON optional; omitted.

## Manual catalogue

GNU coreutils installed date 9.4, date(1); official date invocation manual,
and the actual installed --help/version, inspected before selection.
Source: https://www.gnu.org/software/coreutils/manual/html_node/date-invocation.html

- Display now in local timezone: keep purpose; replace locale-dependent GNU
  default with numeric YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS plus LF (no offset).
- -u/--utc/--universal: keep all aliases; numeric UTC suffix Z plus LF.
- --help: keep; course -h also accepted. Invalid arguments take precedence.
- --version: defer; no packaging/version workflow.
- -d/--date STRING, -f/--file DATEFILE, -r/--reference FILE, --resolution:
  defer; current-clock-only scope, no parsing/file-time/resolution workflow.
  GNU display selectors are mutually exclusive.
- -s/--set STRING and MMDDhhmm[[CC]YY][.ss] operand: defer; never set clock.
- --debug: defer with date parsing.
- -I[FMT]/--iso-8601[=FMT] (date/hours/minutes/seconds/ns), -R/--rfc-email,
  --rfc-3339=FMT (date/seconds/ns): defer; one stable format only.
- +FORMAT: defer broad formatting language. GNU supports literal %, weekday/
  month names, locale date/time, year/century/ISO year, month/day/day-of-year,
  hour/minute/second/nanosecond, epoch, quarter, AM/PM, weeks/weekdays, newline/
  tab and timezone directives; %-/_/0/+ /^/# flags, field widths, E/O modifiers.
  These are not silently supported. GNU defaults zero-pad numeric directives.
- GNU stdout date/help/version, stderr diagnostics, zero success/nonzero failure:
  retain streams; project exact statuses 0 success, 1 operational, 2 syntax.
- GNU locale and TZ influence display; project numeric digits independent of
  locale. Local timezone from libc TZ/default configuration. UTC uses gmtime_r,
  never setenv/unsetenv/putenv. Local calls tzset to refresh libc cache, not TZ
  contents. This is not a promise to preserve libc internal timezone caches.

## Selected behavior and limits

No operands, JSON, custom format, setting, parsing or environmental updates.
Bare -- accepted, subsequent operands rejected; duplicate flags accepted.
Argtable3 defines parse/help. Host argv strings/pointers and exported getopt
values preserved; private getopt scan/thread safety not promised. Stdin and
borrowed fds/cwd/signal dispositions untouched. No owned fds. Parser constructors
and module malloc failure return 1; Argtable internal panic/OOM separate limit.
Read CLOCK_REALTIME once after valid parse, never for help/errors. Use timespec
seconds as time_t, allow negative epochs. Conversion failure and years outside
0000..9999 are errors, no stdout. Numeric snprintf, no strftime dependency.
Validate calendar ranges before arithmetic; tm_sec 60 can be rendered if libc
provides it. POSIX realtime normally ignores leap seconds; no leap-count model.
Discard subseconds; system clock can jump; no monotonicity promise. Local default
is deliberately offset-less/ambiguous at DST folds; use UTC for unique timestamps.
Output retry: short writes/EINTR, zero-write -> EIO, errors return 1; an emitted
prefix cannot be rolled back. Inherited SIGPIPE may terminate process. Explicit
help flush checks stream error and clears failure for subsequent module calls.
Usage callback is void, reports allocation error on its borrowed output stream.

## Planned slices and acceptance

1. Runnable invalid-vector baseline -> valid local clock bytes (synthetic epoch,
   bounded real-clock interval, actual GNU +selected format independent oracle).
2. UTC aliases/help/parser -> GNU selected-format adapter; invalid operands/flags,
   help precedence, --, POSIXLY_CORRECT, no clock call on help/errors.
3. Conversion/clock/range/leap failures, output retry/failure and malloc/constructor
   seams -> reused module, malformed vectors, pointer permutation, getopt sentinels,
   borrowed stdin/fds/cwd/environment/TZ unchanged, help output failure recovery.
4. Registry/main discovery/help/dispatch, repeated piped and real child-owned PTY
   stdin/stdout, inventory/parity/capacity, build/test/lint/scoped format.
5. Freeze HEAD patch/manifest, apply into fresh archive, normal full regression
   and default O0 non-PIE ASan/UBSan full regression, per-checkout TMPDIR.

Six inherited global-format issues and inherited optimized sanitizer-fault
limitations remain separate; no rmdir queries/tests, no shared modifications,
AI_LOG/wiki/push/stage/commit. Original 1237-path preservation plus task inventory
checked before delivery; dependency hashes and exact allowlist recorded externally.

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Capture full command streams without inheriting secret environment values."""
import fcntl
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
BASE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
stage, checkout, *command = sys.argv[1:]
root = BASE / checkout
scratch = BASE / ('tmp-' + checkout)
scratch.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
env = {'PATH': '/home/name/.local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin', 'HOME': '/home/name',
       'LC_ALL': 'C', 'TZ': 'UTC0', 'TMPDIR': str(scratch),
       'ASAN_OPTIONS': 'detect_leaks=1:abort_on_error=1',
       'UBSAN_OPTIONS': 'halt_on_error=1:print_stacktrace=1'}
r = subprocess.run(command, cwd=root, env=env, stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
                   stderr=subprocess.PIPE, timeout=550)
log = BASE / 'execution.log'
lock = (BASE / 'evidence.lock').open('a')
fcntl.flock(lock, fcntl.LOCK_EX)
with log.open('ab') as f:
    f.write(('\n=== ' + stage + ' ===\nCWD ' + str(root) + '\nCMD ' +
             repr(command) + '\nSTDOUT\n').encode())
    f.write(r.stdout)
    f.write(b'\nSTDERR\n' + r.stderr + ('\nSTATUS ' + str(r.returncode) + '\n').encode())
ledger = BASE / 'ledger.json'
data = json.loads(ledger.read_text()) if ledger.exists() else []
data.append({'stage': stage, 'cwd': str(root), 'command': command,
             'status': r.returncode, 'stdout_size': len(r.stdout),
             'stderr_size': len(r.stderr),
             'stdout_sha256': hashlib.sha256(r.stdout).hexdigest(),
             'stderr_sha256': hashlib.sha256(r.stderr).hexdigest()})
ledger.write_text(json.dumps(data, indent=2) + '\n')
print(stage, 'status', r.returncode, 'stdout bytes', len(r.stdout),
      'stderr bytes', len(r.stderr))
print((r.stdout + r.stderr)[-5000:].decode(errors='backslashreplace'))
raise SystemExit(r.returncode)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Fresh scratch-only behavioral mutants; require defect-specific markers."""
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
BASE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
ROOT = Path.cwd()
source = (ROOT / 'src/cmd_date.c').read_text()
flags = ['-std=c17', '-Wall', '-Wextra', '-Wpedantic', '-Wformat=2', '-g3', '-O0',
         '-Isrc', '-Ibuild/argtable3/include']
wrap = '-Wl,--wrap=arg_lit0,--wrap=arg_end,--wrap=arg_parse,--wrap=write,' + \
       '--wrap=clock_gettime,--wrap=gmtime_r,--wrap=localtime_r,--wrap=snprintf'
variants = [
    ('utc-ignored', 'emit(((struct arg_lit *)table[UTC])->count != 0)',
     'emit(0)', b'DATE_OUTPUT_LENGTH'),
    ('caller-argv', 'arg_parse(argc, copy, table)',
     'arg_parse(argc, argv, table)', b'DATE_ARGV_POINTER'),
    ('getopt-state', 'optind = saved_optind;',
     '(void)saved_optind;', b'DATE_GETOPT'),
    ('bad-calendar', 'calendar.tm_mon < 0 || calendar.tm_mon > 11 ||',
     '0 ||', b'DATE_STATUS'),
    ('output-ignored', 'return lines_write((const unsigned char *)output, (size_t)length);',
     '(void)lines_write((const unsigned char *)output, (size_t)length);\n    return 0;',
     b'DATE_STATUS'),
]
for name, old, new, marker in variants:
    assert source.count(old) == 1
    mutant = BASE / (name + '.c')
    mutant.write_text(source.replace(old, new))
    obj = BASE / (name + '.o')
    binary = BASE / name
    compile_cmd = ['cc', *flags, '-Dmalloc=date_test_malloc', '-Dfree=date_test_free',
                   '-c', str(mutant), '-o', str(obj)]
    link_cmd = ['cc', *flags, 'tests/test_date_module.c', str(obj),
                'src/cmd_lines.c', wrap, '-Lbuild/argtable3/lib', '-largtable3',
                '-lm', '-o', str(binary)]
    for command in [compile_cmd, link_cmd]:
        r = subprocess.run(command, capture_output=True, timeout=30)
        print('COMMAND', command, 'STATUS', r.returncode)
        print(r.stdout.decode(errors='backslashreplace'))
        print(r.stderr.decode(errors='backslashreplace'))
        assert r.returncode == 0, 'mutant setup failure'
    r = subprocess.run([str(binary)], capture_output=True, timeout=30)
    print('RUN', name, 'STATUS', r.returncode, 'STDOUT', repr(r.stdout),
          'STDERR', repr(r.stderr))
    assert r.returncode != 0 and marker in r.stderr, (name, marker, r)
print('Five genuine behavioral mutants rejected with intended markers.')

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Authenticate fixed inventories, HEAD and unchanged checkout anchors."""
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import re
import subprocess
BASE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
SHARED = Path('/home/name/Documents/420-EMBDX/A')
HEAD = '08d4bc5b7e26c2016bfc2594dcfd711abd044a37'

def fingerprint(path):
    if path.is_symlink():
        return {'link': os.readlink(path)}
    if path.is_file():
        return {'sha256': hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
                'mode': path.stat().st_mode}
    return {'absent': True}

assert subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], cwd=SHARED).decode().strip() == HEAD
assert not subprocess.check_output(['git', 'diff', '--cached', '--name-only'], cwd=SHARED)
results = []
for inventory in [BASE / 'shared-inventory.json',
                  Path('/home/name/.hermes/cache/scratch/echo-index-20261009-120259/preservation-before.json')]:
    saved = json.loads(inventory.read_text())
    changed = []
    for name, before in saved.items():
        now = fingerprint(SHARED / name)
        if before != now:
            changed.append({'path': name, 'before': before, 'after': now})
    results.append({'inventory': str(inventory), 'count': len(saved),
                    'changed': changed})
    assert not changed, changed
log = (BASE / 'execution.log').read_bytes()
# Exact candidate and baseline format diagnostics must be identical.
segments = log.split(b'\n=== ')
formats = {}
for segment in segments:
    stage = segment.split(b' ===', 1)[0].decode(errors='replace')
    if stage in ['global-format', 'baseline-global-format']:
        stderr = segment.split(b'\nSTDERR\n', 1)[1].rsplit(b'\nSTATUS ', 1)[0]
        formats[stage] = stderr
assert formats['global-format'] == formats['baseline-global-format']
paths = sorted(set(re.findall(rb'(?m)^([^\n:]+):\d+:\d+: error:', formats['global-format'])))
assert len(paths) == 6, paths
allow = (BASE / 'allowlist.txt').read_text().splitlines()
for name in allow:
    if name.endswith(('.c', '.h')):
        lines = (BASE / 'candidate' / name).read_bytes().split(b'\n')
        assert all(len(line) <= 80 for line in lines), name
print('HEAD and empty shared index authenticated.')
print('Preservation:', [(r['count'], len(r['changed'])) for r in results])
print('Six identical inherited format paths:', [p.decode() for p in paths])
print('Changed C/header 80-column bound passed.')
(BASE / 'preservation-result.json').write_text(json.dumps(results, indent=2) + '\n')
